resources.string: Development foundation only. No business feature is available.
This information screen does not open the database. STORE access initializes private storage.
Kotlin, adaptive Compose and typed navigation. Identity and configuration foundation; no sales workflow.
Create the Owner account, then configure shop settings. There is no default password.
Each person signs in with their own credentials. Sign-in does not record attendance. Check rights before acting.
Open an authorized cash session, enter items, check exact amounts, and validate. The receipt is stored locally. Close cash before switching users.
Drafts do not change stock. Check quantities before validating. A validated operation must not be applied twice.
Messages stay on this device. Choose a recipient or use authorized broadcast. Hiding a message does not remove it for others.
Data stay on this device. Create and export a backup from Backup and recovery, then keep it in a safe location. Restore and reset are Owner-only and require confirmation.
PDF documents can be saved, printed, or shared from authorized screens. Emails are queued and their status can be checked; Android sharing does not mean an email was sent.
Stop operations if integrity fails; never reset to fix a login failure. Check cash and current identity during handover.

Reports use the selected date interval [start, day after end) and timezone. Validated revenue sums recognized revenue from validated sales; cancelled sales are excluded. Transactions count validated sales, not line items. Average basket is revenue divided by validated transaction count (zero when there are none). Estimated gross margin is allocated validated line revenue minus quantity times the saved unit cost; when cost is missing, unit price is used and the result is an estimate, not certified profit. Purchase totals are unavailable when a common currency is not recorded; unavailable is not zero. Stock summary is current stock, while movement rows use the selected period. Attendance hours use ended sessions and their recorded durations.
Sum of recognized revenue allocated to validated sales in the selected period. Cancelled sales are excluded. The displayed currency is the report currency.
Count of validated sales in the selected period. A sale counts once regardless of its number of product lines; cancelled sales are not included.
Validated revenue divided by the number of validated sales in the selected period. It is zero when there are no validated sales and uses the report currency.
Count of sales whose current status is cancelled. Their revenue is excluded from validated revenue.
For validated sales: allocated line revenue minus quantity multiplied by the saved unit cost. If a cost is missing, unit price is used as a fallback. This is an estimate, not certified profit.
